payload.core_mechanism_summary: Check if there exists a divisor i of m such that i >= k or m/i >= k. If so, set p = n (number of logs), else p = 0. Winner is Marsel if p is even, else Timur.
payload.rationale: Code contains no DP: no table, no recursion, no state. It's a direct mathematical parity argument. Forced to pick DP subtype; dp_1d_state is conceptually the closest (single parameter: log length) even though not implemented.
